question: What qualities of devotion and association characterize those aligned with the teacher and others?
premises: They are united and associated with the teacher and so on
They are devoted and full of affection
inference: Right association is marked by unity, devotion, and affection
uncertainties: This verse reads as a descriptive gloss on a prior category
plain_english: United with the teacher and so on, associated, devoted, and full of affection.
